title: Bayern Munich Signs Moroccan Midfielder Saibari to Five-Year Deal
summary: German football club Bayern Munich has signed Moroccan midfielder Saibari to a five-year contract. The move is part of the team's efforts to strengthen its midfield. Saibari, who was born in Morocco, joins Bayern from another European club. The signing marks an important addition to the team's squad ahead of the upcoming season.
summary_points: Bayern Munich has signed Moroccan midfielder Saibari to a five-year contract
The move is part of the team's efforts to strengthen its midfield
Saibari joins Bayern from another European club
The signing marks an important addition to the team's squad ahead of the upcoming season
Bayern Munich has announced the signing without specifying details on Saibari's transfer fee or other terms
